subject: MAP Kickoff — draft milestones, owners & close-window options
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jon Walters <jon.walters@brightsidehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Kickoff — draft milestones, owners & close-window options

Hi Jon and team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation and lots of alignment on product fit. Per our discussion, I attached an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v0.1_Evelyn_Brightside.xlsx) and a one-page discovery summary (discovery-notes-brightside.pdf).

High-level recap from the call:
- Primary use case: inference for clinical note summarization (batch + streaming endpoints)
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency < 400ms for streaming, token cost target <$0.0009/token, and SOC2-ready security posture
- Key dependencies: SOC 2 report (availability), data residency for PHI, and procurement timing for a Dedicated pool

Proposed MAP (two lightweight options to choose from):

Option A — Accelerated (target close: 2026-09-24)
- Milestone 1 (Week 0): Legal / NDA signed — owner: Brightside Procurement
- Milestone 2 (Week 1): Security snapshot & SOC2 evidence request — owner: Redwood Security (Karthik)
- Milestone 3 (Week 2–3): Pilot deployment (private VPC trial) — owner: Brightside Engineering + Redwood Onboarding (Marissa)
- Milestone 4 (Week 4): Pilot review & go/no-go — owner: Joint

Option B — Measured (target close: 2026-10-15)
- Same milestones, stretched to allow procurement lead time and internal compliance review

Ask from you / next steps:
1) Please confirm preferred timeline (Option A vs B) and add any missing stakeholders (security, legal, platform).
2) Confirm procurement contact and whether a PO or contract signature is the expected path.
3) Any immediate blockers we should add to the MAP (e.g., specific data residency or encryption requirements).

If it helps, I can update the sheet with a column for dependencies and a proposed handoff date for each milestone.

Thanks — I’ll wait for confirmation on timeline and stakeholder list, then circulate v0.2 with owners pinned.

Best,

Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v0.1_Evelyn_Brightside.xlsx (xlsx), discovery-notes-brightside.pdf (pdf)

From: Jon Walters <jon.walters@brightsidehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightsidehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff — draft milestones, owners & close-window options

Evelyn — thanks for the notes and the quick turn. Appreciate two timeline options. A few thoughts from our side: 

1) Stakeholders to add: Sarah Lin (Security, sarah.lin@brightsidehealth.com) and Michael Cruz (Head of IT Ops, michael.cruz@brightsidehealth.com). Procurement is looped (procurement@brightsidehealth.com).
2) We lean toward Option B given our internal compliance calendar, but would like the SOC2 evidence check (Milestone 2) completed before pilot setup. Can Redwood provide a short checklist of the SOC2 artifacts you need?
3) For procurement: likely a PO to start, contract to follow — I’ll confirm the procurement contact name by EOD tomorrow.

One additional ask: add a Milestone 0 for a short technical design call (30–45m) to validate VPC/network requirements before we schedule the pilot. That will avoid rework.

If you can incorporate the two stakeholders and add the design call as Milestone 0, we can sign off internally and pick Option B.

Thanks,

Jon Walters
Sr. Product Manager — Data & Integrations
Brightside Health
jon.walters@brightsidehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0228

Quick internal notes / action items from our side (tracking in the MAP v0.2):

- Milestone 2 (SOC2 evidence checklist): Owner = Karthik Iyer (Redwood Security) — Karthik will circulate a 1-page checklist by EOD 2026-08-14.
- Pilot scheduling: target start Wk of 2026-09-27 (consistent with Option B close window).
- Procurement path: Marissa will coordinate with Brightside procurement once Jon confirms contact name; we will accept PO to initiate pilot billing.

I updated the Drive folder and linked the MAP v0.2 draft here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-MAP-Brightside (read-only link for now). I also linked the HubSpot deal (RDW-2026-BRIGHT-0042) so our CS/Onboarding teams can track progress.

Jon — if those owners and dates look right, I’ll publish v0.2 and send an invite for the design call.
